correctness.rationale: The direct polar reduction gives F=a+η cos2θ+δ cosθ sinθ+ω cosθ sin³θ>0 and angular G=ε+τ√ε sin²θ+ω sin⁴θ. Minimizing G as a quadratic in s=sin²θ gives strictly positive drift exactly for τ>−2√ω and invariant rays otherwise; positive G makes radial square linear in angular time with contractive positive full-turn return and one orbit attracting each r>0. The known exact original-time period identity λT=∫F/G removes odd numerator terms by reflection. At gates 0,π, θ=jπ+ε^(1/4)v yields G/ε→1+τv²+ωv⁴ and the exact integral π/√(τ+2√ω), giving ε^−3/4 slowdown uniformly on compact τ subsets. Damping in the radial angular ODE forces u=r²→λ/(a+η) through each gate; normalized p(θ)=1/(T u G) yields the claimed per-gate density integrating to 1/2. Scheffe upgrades densities to total variation in (gate,v), while planar atoms only converge weakly. Finite independent quadrature checks corroborate constants, not limit proof.
